name: gerudo_valley
label: Gerudo Valley
about: Pieces and textures cut from Gerudo Valley (spot09). Definitions only: the meshes come from the extract (ROM data) into out/. Coordinates are the builder's: x east, y north, z up (glTF's (x, -z, y)). See ADR 0036.

textures.about: Material N -> role (2026-10-09, from the textures and where Gerudo Valley draws them). `ground` is the canyon floor (dirt footsteps), `sand` the sandy road to the fortress in the west, `cliff` (and `cliff_b`, the same image repeating) the canyon walls, `rock` and `cliff_c` the darker rock faces, `bank` (`_b`, `_c`: the same streaked earth, clamped) the low walls under the rims and ledges, `ledge_top` the rims' sandy lip with its dark drips, `sandstone` the striated walls of the passage to the fortress (its stripes run along v, so the scene turns it sideways), `riverbed` the mossy stone under the river, `stone` the block at the top of the ladder and the river's west shelf. `ridge` and `ridge_b` are cut-out crag silhouettes along the rims. The water, waterfalls and foam are translucent.

surfaces.about: Surface type -> collision role (oot_import::level::ROLES), where the default read off the type (kit::default_role) is wrong.

pieces.name: gv_log_bridge
pieces.label: Log bridge
pieces.about: The log over the stream by the Hyrule Field entrance, sloping 150 from end to end; its top collides as wood. The rope bridge over the canyon is an actor (Bg_Spot09_Obj), so it isn't here.

pieces.name: gv_waterfall
pieces.label: Waterfall
pieces.about: The tall fall at the canyon's north end, curling over its lip. Translucent, no collision; the game scrolls its texture, the kit doesn't yet.

pieces.name: gv_waterfall_small
pieces.label: Small waterfall
pieces.about: The trickle into the pool by the Hyrule Field entrance: the stream, the wet streak on the rock behind it and its splash. Translucent, no collision.

pieces.name: gv_ladder
pieces.label: Ladder
pieces.about: The ladder up from the river to the ledge with the Piece of Heart (wall types: ladder, and ladder top over it). Placed on a wall's face it reaches from the floor to the wall's top; only its height scales.

pieces.name: gv_ledge
pieces.label: Stone ledge
pieces.about: The stone block jutting from the cliff at the top of the ladder (120 wide, 140 deep, 120 tall), where the Piece of Heart lies; a strip of ladder-top wall on its front lets a ladder below lead onto it. Locked: sized for Link.

pieces.name: gv_rock_shelf
pieces.label: Rock shelf
pieces.about: The shelf on the canyon's east wall under the bridge, where the grotto is: a stone floor 160 wide and 1000 long, with earth sides 320 deep.
